content.comment_body: Hello, I recently purchased an [product_name] operator device and have a question regarding its power supply. The manual states it supports 24V AC/DC or 12V DC. I am unclear about the meaning of 24V AC/DC. Does it mean I can use either 24V DC or 24V AC interchangeably? Also, why is 12V DC listed as an option? Is it safe to connect the device directly to a 24V DC source, such as a truck battery? Any assistance would be appreciated. Regards,

The allowed supply voltage for this operator device at DC ranges from a minimum of 10.2 volts to a maximum of 28.8 volts. You can connect it directly to a 24V DC source, like a vehicle battery. However, make sure to include a fuse for safety.
